span.p:
services/search.py uses this duck-typed shape.
domain/search/contract.py remains a separate richer Protocol and is not consumed by current generators.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Conceptual name for the persisted candidate dict.
No CandidateEnvelope dataclass exists in the current runtime.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: No DiscoveryController class exists. Mutation, crossover and ensemble are function branches over archive parents; LLM is DiscoveryLLMHTTPAdapter callback.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Current durable controller: Store methods own DB transaction and one active candidate.
Admission creates train first; validation jobs follow a passing train.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reservation row records reserved_jobs=4; it does not enqueue four jobs upfront.
Test partition is created only after an accepted survivor and normal stop.

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p: Unique candidate/partition/ordinal makes event redelivery and restart reconciliation idempotent.
